year_display.zh: 约 1351 年起草，晚年续有修改

edition.en: Latin text as given on Latin Wikisource, which does not name its edition: the two opening paragraphs and paragraphs 11–12.
edition.zh: 据拉丁文维基文库所录拉丁原文（该页未注明所据版本）：开头两段及第 11–12 段。

basis.en: Written in the fourteenth century; the author died in 1374.
basis.zh: 作于十四世纪，作者卒于 1374 年。

note.en: In his late forties Petrarch began a letter addressed to posterity, telling an unknown future reader who he had been, and he was still revising it near the end of his life; it breaks off unfinished. It is on this shelf as one of the first and best known letters of its kind in Europe, written by a man who felt more at home with ancient authors than with his own century. Notice ‘Vestro de grege unus fui’, I was one of your own flock: he writes to the future as to his own kin.
note.zh: 彼特拉克四十多岁时开始写一封致后世的信，向一位未知的未来读者讲述自己曾是怎样一个人，直到晚年仍在修改；这封信没有写完就中断了。它放在这个书架上，因为它是欧洲最早、也最著名的这类书信之一，作者是一个与古代作家相处比与自己的世纪相处更自在的人。留意“我是你们当中的一员”这一句：他把未来的人当作自己的同类来写信。

excerpt.orig: Vestro de grege unus fui autem, mortalis homuncio
excerpt.en: I was, though, one of your own flock: a little mortal man
excerpt.zh: 不过，我是你们当中的一员：一个渺小的凡人

gloss.at: ut de se ait Augustus Cesar
gloss.en: Suetonius reports that Augustus wrote of himself as born of an old and wealthy equestrian family.
gloss.zh: 据苏维托尼乌斯记载，奥古斯都自称出身于一个古老而富有的骑士家族。

gloss.en: Holy Scripture and the writings of the Church Fathers.
gloss.zh: 圣典，指《圣经》和教父们的著作。

gloss.at: mirorque eam curam Augustum Cesarem suscepisse
gloss.en: Suetonius says Augustus wrote out even his more serious private conversations, including those with his wife Livia, and spoke them from notes.
gloss.zh: 据苏维托尼乌斯记载，奥古斯都连较重要的私人谈话，包括与妻子莉维娅的谈话，也要先写下来，照着稿子说。

note.en: An early European letter to posterity by a man more at home with the ancients; unfinished and vain in places, but intimate with its future reader in a new way.
note.zh: 欧洲较早写给后世的书信，出自一个与古人更亲近的人；未完成，偶有自矜，但与未来读者亲切交谈是新的声音。
